description.value: Fairway Market is a Vancouver Island–owned grocery chain founded in 1963, now operating 9 locations including this Langford store at Goldstream Village. The store carries a broad range of departments — deli, meat, produce, dairy, bakery, floral, an Asian kitchen, and a sushi counter — making it a well-stocked resupply point for touring cyclists. The company emphasizes local BC and Island producers alongside an extensive international product selection.
